lines.en: I walk step by step in the tree shadows.
The leaves don't rustle under my feet.
I slip along the trunk.
I know the forest night well.
You can't see me, but I'm walking.
The thorns make way.
Slow walking, but always forward.
I just walked past this tree.
The little roots obey me.
I go around you. Don't turn your head.

lines.zh: 水面反光，我的影子不见。
lines.en: The water shines, and my shadow is gone.

lines.zh: 我踩过苔藓，一点声也没有。
lines.en: I cross the moss without a sound.
I stand behind the tree, perfectly still.

lines.zh: 隐身的时候，我连呼吸都省。
lines.en: While invisible, I don't even breathe.
This whole grove answers to me.
I wait for someone to come close.
Raindrops fall from the leaf tips.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把根须伸进土里。
lines.en: I slowly push my roots into the soil.
Water is over there. I remember.
The night wind is strong. I don't care.
My heartbeat lives inside the trunk.
A little longer. Soon.
I count the falling acorns.

lines.zh: 不动的树最容易被忽略。
lines.en: Still trees are the easiest to overlook.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，看看苔藓长得怎样。
lines.en: I raise a hand to check how the moss is doing.
The wood is so quiet. I like it.
Light leaks through the leaves.
An axe? I heard that.
I pull myself into the bark.

lines.zh: 我等着，等你离水远一点。
lines.en: I wait until you're far from water.

lines.zh: 你终于看见我这身树皮了。
lines.en: You finally see this bark of mine.
This close, I have to show myself.
Is that an axe in your hand?
This forest does not welcome you.
Did you think trees were dead?
I'm within six paces.
You don't smell of wood.

lines.zh: 我藏在树后，六格内才现身。
lines.en: I hide behind trees, showing at six blocks.
You snapped a twig.
I've got my eye on you, stranger.
Don't go near that old tree.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛，和树皮一个色。
lines.en: My eyes are the color of bark.
You're walking on leaves. I can hear it.

lines.zh: 你把手按在树干上，找什么？
lines.en: You put your hand on the trunk. Looking for something?
You cut me.
The bark split open.
I'm not so easy to cut down.
At that blow, the branches shuddered.

lines.zh: 森林里我隐身，你找不到。
lines.en: Hidden in the forest, you can't find me.
The bark split and the heartwood shows.
Don't make me pull up my roots.
My wounds will grow back.
You missed. The trees are laughing.
The forest does not forget.
Is that sweet, in your hand?

lines.zh: 木头以外的东西，我少见。
lines.en: I rarely see things other than wood.
Put it on the ground. Let me look.
Don't think that buys my forest.
Give it to me, and I will trade you roots.

lines.zh: 我闻到甜味，从你口袋里。
lines.en: I smell something sweet in your pocket.
Step back two paces, then I'll come.
I rarely eat, but I'm curious.
Hold it up a little higher.
Put it down, then go.
Bumping into me is like hitting a trunk.

lines.zh: 我挡在路中间，树皮也挡着。
lines.en: I block the middle of the path, bark and all.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀蹭到我的荆棘。
lines.en: Your shoulder brushed my thorns.
Don't push. I'm prickly.
I don't budge at all.
You charge, and I scatter into leaves.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，树都晃了。
lines.en: We collide and the trees shake.
You squeezed past me.
Touch me and your skin itches.
Your blade slid through me.
There is another me in the wood.
Our roots will slowly twine.
Don't peek. Trees get shy too.
She hides behind the maple.

lines.zh: 夜里，两个影子合成一个。
lines.en: At night, two shadows become one.
Our leaves will fall together.
This forest will grow a little greener.
You're standing on our roots.

lines.zh: 我们绕着彼此走了三圈。
lines.en: We walked three circles around each other.
Tomorrow there'll be one more dewdrop.
This piece of wood is mine.
Gold nuggets? I'll store them in my hollow.
A parcel, still sealed.
I lift it gently.
This wood goes into my hollow.
This book must be about nature.
My fingers are long enough to reach.
The roots will watch it for me.
Did this come out of the soil?
I'll bury it and dig it up later.
You're too far from the water.
Now I step out.
You have disturbed my forest.
I see your axe.
Don't run. The roots will trip you.
Within six paces, you can't escape.
My eyes are in the trees.
You crushed the saplings. Time to pay.
The grove will strike for me.
You turned. Perfect.
I've locked onto your scent.
Let's begin, woodcutter.
I follow behind you, slowly.
I know every blade you stepped on.
Don't look back. You won't see me anyway.
I'm hiding in the trunk.
Your axe hit nothing.
I'm waiting for you to reach the water.
A bit closer and I can grab you.

lines.zh: 我藏在树干里，等你靠近六格。
lines.en: I hide in the trunk until you are six blocks off.
I put thorns in your path.
You go left, I go around the left.
I stand invisible behind you.
I'm in no hurry. Trees are patient.
You snapped a branch. I remember.
One swipe and the bark splits.
Thorns wrap around your hand.
Wood can bite too.
You were knocked back.
Now you'll struggle to swing that axe.
My hand slides into your armor.
Roots rise and wrap your legs.
You fall onto the leaves.
And another. Don't rush.

lines.zh: 森林的力气，都在我身上。
lines.en: The forest's strength is in me.
The leaves rustle, and I am here.
I step out of the trunk.
The moss parts and shows my face.
What you hear is the trees breathing.

lines.zh: 夜里的森林，多了一个我。
lines.en: The night forest has one more of me.
I rise from under the roots.
The wind pushes leaves to my feet.
I form unseen. You can't catch me.
Dew settles on my shoulders.
The wood knows me, and I know it.
I'm here. Don't cut the trees.
The moss opens a seam.
My fingers are harder than bark.

lines.zh: 一根新芽在我脚边冒头。
lines.en: A new shoot rises by my foot.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我整棵树都在叫。
lines.en: When fire touches me, my whole tree screams.
A fall? Trees are tall by nature.

lines.zh: 水里我不怕，反倒更有劲。
lines.en: Water doesn't scare me. It makes me stronger.

lines.zh: 炸开的气浪，把我的叶子掀了。
lines.en: The blast tore my leaves away.
The arrow sticks in me like a thorn.
The spell binds my roots. It hurts.

lines.zh: 没有阳光，没有土，我在枯。
lines.en: No sun, no soil. I am withering.

lines.zh: 雷劈到树上，我整个都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning struck the tree, and I went numb.
There are no roots in the void, so I float.
